name: Critical Path
source: Briar's life at work has been really difficult. She's constantly dealing with stress and anxiety and what others think, and things are made exceedingly worse by the fact known office bully, Kira, is regularly picking fights with her. Things start to get worse after a particularly important conference event goes wrong.
